scientific_limitations: Finite-sample inequality applies to planar convex bodies with uniform boundary arclength sampling, and the curvature-cube expansion assumes a fixed C4 convex unit-speed boundary. title: Sharp finite-sample perimeter isoperimetry and fourth-order curvature memory for random boundary polygons
